mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness that depresses earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 255) triggers monetary tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 18700) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 exceeds 18700.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 105.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market slowdown (HOUST < 1150) reduces household wealth and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1150.
